run_contract.current_combined_cli_and_archive: not run; validate both from same final revision and recorded archive hash
run_contract.additional_modes: Select supported location/call/change question modes after verifying final CLI help; record exact commands and scope. No assertion that Python/Java direct calls currently exist.
run_contract.preflight: Verify commit IDs, clean trees, selected source hashes; no expected answer comes from analyzer. Freeze each added atomic question and source/runtime oracle before its first analysis.

classification.unit: one pre-enumerated source target or explicit supported-boundary assertion at one revision; preserve one-to-many mappings and evidence lines
classification.correct-target: target and scope match independent expected result
classification.wrong-target: a concrete target asserted but mismatches oracle, including fabricated target for unsupported case
classification.omitted: no target and no explicit unknown, including skipped file unless separately reported
classification.explicit-unknown: an explicit unresolved/unsupported result, with reason; never credit as target recovered

metrics.supported_recall: correct-target / all supported expected target units (including wrong, omitted, unknown)
metrics.resolved_precision: correct-target / (correct-target + wrong-target) for asserted targets; report count and undefined when zero
metrics.unknown_rate: explicit-unknown / all expected units, separately supported and unsupported
metrics.unsupported_boundary: correctly signaled unknown / all unsupported units; report wrong concrete targets and silent omissions separately
metrics.coverage: captured and parsed files / eligible scoped source files; distinguish ignored, unsupported and parse failures; separately report project, revision, question and target unit denominators
metrics.runtime_oracles: separate narrative/runtime results from product facts; never count manual source lookup as analyzer recovery
